verses.text: O God, keep not thou silence: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

segments.text: O God, keep not thou silence:
Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

verses.text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult; And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

segments.text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult;
And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

verses.text: They take crafty counsel against thy people, And consult together against thy hidden ones.

segments.text: They take crafty counsel against thy people,
And consult together against thy hidden ones.

verses.text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

segments.text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation;
That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

verses.text: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against thee do they make a covenant:

segments.text: For they have consulted together with one consent;
Against thee do they make a covenant:

verses.text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagarenes;

segments.text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites;
Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre:

segments.text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek;
Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre:

verses.text: Assyria also is joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. [Selah

segments.text: Assyria also is joined with them;
They have helped the children of Lot. [Selah

verses.text: Do thou unto them as unto Midian, As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

segments.text: Do thou unto them as unto Midian,
As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

verses.text: Who perished at Endor, Who became as dung for the earth.

segments.text: Who perished at Endor,
Who became as dung for the earth.

verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; Yea, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

segments.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb;
Yea, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

verses.text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.

segments.text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves in possession
The habitations of God.

verses.text: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.

segments.text: O my God, make them like the whirling dust;
As stubble before the wind.

verses.text: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains on fire,

segments.text: As the fire that burneth the forest,
And as the flame that setteth the mountains on fire,

verses.text: So pursue them with thy tempest, And terrify them with thy storm.

segments.text: So pursue them with thy tempest,
And terrify them with thy storm.

verses.text: Fill their faces with confusion, That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.

segments.text: Fill their faces with confusion,
That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.

verses.text: Let them be put to shame and dismayed for ever; Yea, let them be confounded and perish;

segments.text: Let them be put to shame and dismayed for ever;
Yea, let them be confounded and perish;

verses.text: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, Art the Most High over all the earth.

segments.text: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah,
Art the Most High over all the earth.

headings.text: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph.
